rms_formula: Sample standard deviation of residual times normalized VELEST weights, not unweighted RMS; weight S/P=0.5 and sum(weights)=n.
epoch_sampling: First retained arrival per station and UTC day; complete interval intersections audited separately.
interpretation: Precision agreement is established, but continued iterations do not converge to stable locations. Fitted model remains exploratory; residual and covariance reductions do not establish accuracy.
